easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Yannik until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
